name: Lancelot
source:
Imperial guard and childhood friend of the king and third son of noble family.
Being driven out of the castle town because of a trick, he came to find a sacred woman.
He has poker-face and is always cool but goofy sometimes.
He likes sweets.

"Stay with me forever, if possible."

[From Google Play]
